summary: Final PRE-DEPLOY regression run in PREVIEW only (no deploy, no payments, no real email sends, no app code changes). Every requested area PASSED and there are NO blocking issues. Backend: the requested suites gave 76 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed. The new regression file tests/test_predeploy_regression.py gave 39/39 passed. It covers auth register/login/me/401, package prices, legacy reminders CRUD, referral, Stripe checkout session creation (cs_live, not paid), PayPal/crypto config, admin gating (401 without the token and with a wrong token, 200 with ADMIN_TOKEN), deletion_enabled=false, assistant config, all 13 QR assets returning 200, and SPA routes. All 7 PNG QR codes decoded with cv2 to https://docuanalytics.online/assistant?utm_... Frontend: home loads and the language switcher works for it/en/es/de/fr. The pricing preview shows 19/49/149 and 29/99/299, matching /api/packages, and the credits badge is shown. In the AuthModal, the Google button is present, UI login and logout work, and UI registration correctly showed a 429 message because the 5/hour per-IP limit had been used up by the suites. Registration via the API passed. Uploading an invoice PNG ran a real analysis (credits 3 to 2) and showed extracted fields and the Red-Flag Audit. The analysis appears in the Storico modal (detail and reopen work) and in /area Documenti. Copilot answered 'Il totale della fattura è 1.830,00 EUR'. The first copilot try returned 502 only because the test suite was restarting the backend at that moment. The referral modal works. Stripe 'Acquista' redirects to a checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_live_... URL (the navigation was blocked by the test, nothing was paid). The PayPal panel and buttons render, and the crypto tab shows the BTC/USDT wallet. /admin/assistant and /admin/privacy reject a wrong token and load with ADMIN_TOKEN; the privacy page shows 'Cancellazione reale: disabilitata (solo simulazione)'. The 5 sector pages, /blog, /blog/:slug, the blog not-found view and /privacy (with the 'Bozza in revisione' banner) all load. /assistant shows 'Assistente online'; choosing a profile sends a message and gets a real reply in 3.1s, followed by 3 suggested questions and the CTA bar. The homepage assistant promo, QR, share menu, copy link and SVG/PNG download controls are present; the promo button goes to /assistant?utm_source=site. /area: anonymous users are blocked; dashboard, clients, documents, deadlines, calendar export, digest toggle and studio settings (in the Clients view) render with seeded data. Mobile at 390px: home, /assistant and /area have no horizontal overflow. There were no backend 5xx during this run and no blocking console errors.

minor.issue: There is no timeout around chat.send_message. During the run one Gemini call (10:06:46) never completed for more than 2 minutes, so the gpt-5.4-mini fallback never ran and the UI stayed on 'Sto scrivendo…'. An immediate retry answered in 1.3s, so the cause is transient provider latency. Wrapping each provider attempt in asyncio.wait_for (about 25s) would make the fallback work. The same applies to /api/analyze and /api/chat in server.py.

These tests run 'supervisorctl restart backend', which causes 502s for any request made at the same time. That is why the first copilot attempt failed. test_assistant.py also makes about 4 real AI calls even with SMOKE_REAL_AI=0.

ui_bugs.issue: Legacy 'Promemoria' UI is dead code: createReminder, remSaved, remBusy and deadline are defined but never rendered. No reminder or Promemoria modal button exists on the home result view. Reminders can only be managed in /area Scadenze. The legacy /api/reminders CRUD itself works.

issues: The header wraps to 4 rows (Guide, Area, lang, Crediti, Ricarica, Invita, user, logout) and uses about 175px before the hero. It works but is heavy. Consider a hamburger menu.
React dev warning: <span> inside <option> (hydration warning). It comes from the visual-edit dev instrumentation, not the production build. Not blocking.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): add asyncio.wait_for timeouts around LLM send_message in assistant _ask_llm (so the provider fallback triggers), /api/analyze and /api/chat
Optional: remove the dead createReminder code in Results or restore the 'Crea promemoria email' button for contract/F24 deadlines
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking issues found for deploy
LLM calls have no timeout (assistant/router.py _ask_llm, server.py analyze and chat_copilot). A hung provider stalls the request with no fallback.
JWT_SECRET falls back to 'change-me' in code (server.py ~1232). It is set in .env, but production secrets must include JWT_SECRET.
App.js (2366 lines) and server.py (1533 lines) are far over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting after launch.
GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} is unauthenticated (low risk because session ids are unguessable)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested areas (1 transient copilot 502 caused by the suite restart; passed on retry)
